answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization is the task of automatically generating digests for an entity (e.g. a product, a hotel, a service, etc.), from user opinions in online forums.
answer_1.outputs: opinion summaries for entities (hotels, products, etc.)

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE F-scores that compares the overlap between generated text with gold summaries. For SPACE dataset, we measure how much general summaries cover different aspects by computing the mean ROUGE-L score with the gold aspect summaries (denoted by RL ASP). We also compute perplexity (PPL) score to evaluate the readability of summaries.

answer_4.quote: Summaries were judged by 3 human annotators on three criteria: informativeness, coherence and non-redundancy.
answer_4.guideline: The judges were presented summaries in a pairwise manner and asked to select which one was better/worse/similar. The scores (-100 to +100) were computed using Best-Worst Scaling.
